thread:
secops-bot: Alert — Multiple 403s on /scim/v2/Users in eu-west-1 since 07:23 UTC. Spike correlates with KMS key rotation job #2026-03-22T07:20Z :rotating_light:
mira: seeing same. SCIM bulk failed, provisioning queue backing up. Any KMS rotation change?
sam: yes, we rotated alias redwood-scim-eu-key at 07:19. ops ran automated rotate script.
ophelia: link to logs: https://logs.company/internal/stream/abcd — errors show 'decrypt failed: wrong key' for service-account 'scim-worker-eu'
kevin: that explains it — when KMS cipher version changed, our SCIM envelope headers weren't updated. RBAC write calls failed with 403 from identity-proxy.
mira: can we fallback to previous key? ops: rolling back is possible but need approval.
sam: quick mitigation — switch SCIM worker to use KMS alias versioned ARN in env override: `KMS_KEY_ARN=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/old-key-id`
ophelia: testing override now... got success for single user create
mira: nice. let's backfill queued updates after we confirm integrity and audit logs.
kevin: audit note — any rollback must be recorded with JIRA #SEC-4217 and include KMS key IDs + who triggered
sam: added an entry, patching deployment to add feature flag `scim_kms_fallback=true`
ophelia: watch logs for 401 vs 403. I still see 'sso: NameID format mismatch' on some requests — looks like SAML NameID format flipped from email to persistent during recent IdP config push
mira: oh. we changed NameID format in the IdP for Okta federation last night as part of RBAC cleanup. Could cause duplicate principal mapping.
kevin: if NameID changed then SCIM externalId may not match existing users leading to 403 on RBAC update. Need to re-link by extID mapping or prefer email-based matching for fallbacks.
sam: rolling a hotfix to mapping code — fallback to email when externalId not found. will run on canary.
ophelia: can we confirm that audit logs show original extId values before change? Security: we need to capture pre- and post-rotate audit trails.
mira: @sam @kevin also confirm KMS did not re-encrypt existing DB blobs with new key id — I think rotation created new key but left ciphertext; only decrypts using new key mapping which failed.
sam: confirmed — rotation created new CMK with new key id, but alias swap happened fast; some services saw new ARN, some still had cached key id.
ophelia: Decrypt errors in logs show KMS RequestID 1234-5678; raised ticket with AWS support.
kevin: ACTIONS: 1) enable scim_kms_fallback on eu workers (sam) 2) rollback IdP NameID change for Okta temporarily (mira) 3) backfill queued SCIM ops after sanity checks (ophelia) 4) attach audit/incident note SEC-4217 (mira)
sam: deploying canary now :shipit: 
ophelia: canary looks good — 8/8 sample creates succeeded
mira: rolling IdP NameID back — coordinating with SSO team, ETA 12m
kevin: update incident doc with KMS key ids: old=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/old-key-id new=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/new-key-id
mira: once stable, we'll run a regression eval on provisioning flows and add a test to catch NameID format drift in CI
ophelia: adding log alert to trigger on 'decrypt failed: wrong key' string and on sudden SCIM queue length increase
sam: closing loop — will post postmortem draft to #postmortems in ~2 hours
secops-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated by mira at 07:47 UTC — SCIM queue drained, no new errors in 10m :white_check_mark:
